visual.name: reportingGantt
visual.description: Reporting Roadmap — generic timeline visual for Power BI. Activity swim lanes, chevron time axis, milestone markers with conditional left/right labels, optional per-row Notes shown on hover for activities and milestones. Data-driven: any swim-lane names, any milestone-type names (cap 2 types / 8 lanes). Per-value color overrides via Format pane, per-type symbol/size/color/visibility controls, customizable Title card, full font controls on every text element, structured tooltips with header + dates + note section.
